newsitem.title: ISRAEL: EU gives $4.7 million to Palestinian universities.
newsitem.headline: EU gives $4.7 million to Palestinian universities.

text.p: The European Commission said it gave the Palestinian Authority $4.7 million on Thursday to help upgrade university facilities in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

The commission representative in Jerusalem, Thiery Bechet, was present when Palestinian Higher Education Minister Hanan Ashrawi signed the aid agreement at her office in the West Bank town of Ramallah.
A commission statement said the aid would go to upgrading university laboratories, workshops and libraries to the benefit of 34,000 students and about 1,600 academic staff.
The European Union, the Palestinian Authority's biggest donor, said the money was the latest in a series of grants totalling about $77 million for Palestinian universities given since 1993.
